metadata.description: Phase-4 CQ 15개 — 최신 데이터 우선·페르소나 시나리오 기반 CR 변경근거·Cross-Spec·CRPack·연계분석

sort_rules.CQ2: 영향 Spec 수 DESC, Spec 번호 ASC
sort_rules.CQ3: TSG Meeting DESC, CR 수 DESC
sort_rules.CQ4: Meeting 번호 DESC, CR 번호 ASC

personas: 표준 엔지니어: CR 변경 근거·영향 분석
WG 의장/라포르터: CRPack 구성·회의 결과 종합
시스템 아키텍트: Cross-Spec 연쇄 영향 파악
기업 대표: 자사 기고문의 Cross-Spec 영향 추적

questions.question: LP-WUS/WUR 도입을 위해 5개 Spec에 영향을 주는 CR R1-2504971의 변경이 필요한 구체적 이유는 무엇인가?
questions.cypher: MATCH (cr:CR {tdocNumber: 'R1-2504971'}) WHERE cr.reasonForChange IS NOT NULL RETURN cr.tdocNumber, cr.reasonForChange

questions.question: Rel-19 UL Tx switching 3Tx UE 시나리오 도입 관련 CR R1-2506685의 변경 내용 요약은 무엇인가?
questions.cypher: MATCH (cr:CR {tdocNumber: 'R1-2506685'}) WHERE cr.summaryOfChange IS NOT NULL RETURN cr.tdocNumber, cr.summaryOfChange

questions.question: Rel-19 LP-WUS/WUR(NR_LPWUS-Core) Work Item 관련 CR들이 승인되지 않으면 어떤 영향이 발생하는가?
questions.cypher: MATCH (cr:CR)-[:RELATED_TO]->(wi:WorkItem {workItemCode: 'NR_LPWUS-Core'}) WHERE cr.consequencesIfNotApproved IS NOT NULL RETURN cr.tdocNumber, cr.consequencesIfNotApproved ORDER BY cr.tdocNumber DESC

questions.question: CR R1-2504971이 영향을 주는 5개 Spec 목록과 각 Spec에 대한 영향 관계 유형(Core/Test/OM)은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (cr:CR {tdocNumber: 'R1-2504971'})-[r:AFFECTS_CORE_SPEC|AFFECTS_TEST_SPEC|AFFECTS_OM_SPEC]->(sp:Spec) RETURN cr.tdocNumber, sp.specNumber, type(r) AS relationType ORDER BY sp.specNumber ASC

questions.question: 38.214를 수정하는 CR들이 가장 많이 Cross-Spec 영향을 주는 다른 Spec은 무엇이며, 각각 몇 건의 CR이 영향을 주는가?
questions.cypher: MATCH (cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(mainSpec:Spec {specNumber: '38.214'}) MATCH (cr)-[:AFFECTS_CORE_SPEC|AFFECTS_TEST_SPEC|AFFECTS_OM_SPEC]->(otherSpec:Spec) WHERE mainSpec <> otherSpec RETURN mainSpec.specNumber AS modifiedSpec, otherSpec.specNumber AS affectedSpec, count(DISTINCT cr) AS crCount ORDER BY crCount DESC

questions.question: 38.214를 Cross-Spec 영향 대상으로 참조하는 CR은 총 몇 건이며, 대표적인 CR 번호는?
questions.cypher: MATCH (cr:CR)-[:AFFECTS_CORE_SPEC|AFFECTS_TEST_SPEC|AFFECTS_OM_SPEC]->(sp:Spec {specNumber: '38.214'}) WITH sp, collect(cr.tdocNumber) AS crList, count(cr) AS crCount RETURN sp.specNumber, crCount, crList[..10] AS sampleCRs

questions.question: Cross-Spec 영향 범위가 가장 넓은 CR Top 10은 무엇이며, 각 CR이 영향을 주는 Spec 수와 목록은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (cr:CR)-[:AFFECTS_CORE_SPEC|AFFECTS_TEST_SPEC|AFFECTS_OM_SPEC]->(sp:Spec) RETURN cr.tdocNumber, count(DISTINCT sp) AS affectedSpecCount, collect(DISTINCT sp.specNumber) AS affectedSpecs ORDER BY affectedSpecCount DESC, cr.tdocNumber ASC LIMIT 10

questions.question: RAN#109에 제출된 CRPack RP-252634에 포함된 CR 목록과 각 CR의 변경 요약은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (pack:CRPack {crPackId: 'RP-252634'})-[:HAS_CR]->(cr:CR) RETURN pack.crPackId, pack.tsgMeeting, cr.tdocNumber, cr.summaryOfChange ORDER BY cr.tdocNumber ASC

questions.question: NR 초기 규격(NR_newRAT-Core) Work Item의 CR들이 어떤 CR Pack들에 묶여 TSG에 제출되었는가?
questions.cypher: MATCH (cr:CR)-[:RELATED_TO]->(wi:WorkItem {workItemCode: 'NR_newRAT-Core'}) MATCH (cr)-[:BELONGS_TO_CR_PACK]->(pack:CRPack) RETURN wi.workItemCode, pack.crPackId, pack.tsgMeeting, count(cr) AS crCount ORDER BY toInteger(split(pack.tsgMeeting, '#')[1]) DESC, crCount DESC LIMIT 15

questions.question: RAN#109 회의에 제출된 CR Pack 목록과 각 Pack에 포함된 CR 수는?
questions.cypher: MATCH (pack:CRPack)-[:HAS_CR]->(cr:CR) WHERE pack.tsgMeeting = 'RAN#109' RETURN pack.tsgMeeting, pack.crPackId, count(cr) AS crCount ORDER BY crCount DESC

questions.question: 38.214 Section 5.1.5 (PDSCH MIMO 관련)를 변경하는 최근 CR들의 변경 이유 패턴은 무엇인가? (최근 최다 수정 Section)
questions.cypher: MATCH (cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES_SECTION]->(sec:Section {sectionNumber: '5.1.5'})-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(:Spec {specNumber: '38.214'}) WHERE cr.reasonForChange IS NOT NULL RETURN sec.sectionId, cr.tdocNumber, cr.reasonForChange ORDER BY cr.tdocNumber DESC LIMIT 15

questions.question: Resolution AGR-115-7.1-004가 승인한 CR들의 변경 근거와 변경 내용 요약은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (res:Resolution {resolutionId: 'AGR-115-7.1-004'})-[:HAS_DISPOSITION]->(:DecisionDisposition {dispositionCode: 'agreed', evidenceStatus: 'source_verified'})-[:DISPOSITION_TARGET]->(cr:CR) RETURN res.resolutionId, cr.tdocNumber, cr.reasonForChange, cr.summaryOfChange ORDER BY cr.tdocNumber ASC
questions.approval_contract: Target-level dispositionCode=agreed + evidenceStatus=source_verified, bound to the exact Resolution and source span; REFERENCES and global document status do not assert approval.

questions.question: NR MIMO Evolution(NR_MIMO_evo_DL_UL-Core) Work Item의 CR들이 변경한 TS Section 전체 목록과 각 변경 이유는?
questions.cypher: MATCH (cr:CR)-[:RELATED_TO]->(wi:WorkItem {workItemCode: 'NR_MIMO_evo_DL_UL-Core'}) MATCH (cr)-[:MODIFIES_SECTION]->(sec:Section) WHERE cr.reasonForChange IS NOT NULL RETURN wi.workItemCode, sec.sectionId, cr.tdocNumber, cr.reasonForChange ORDER BY cr.tdocNumber DESC, sec.sectionId ASC LIMIT 15

questions.question: Samsung이 제출한 CR 중 Cross-Spec 영향이 있는 최근 건들의 영향 Spec 분포 패턴은? (최다 Cross-Spec 기업, 최신 우선)
questions.cypher: MATCH (cr:CR)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(co:Company {companyName: 'Samsung'}) MATCH (cr)-[:AFFECTS_CORE_SPEC|AFFECTS_TEST_SPEC|AFFECTS_OM_SPEC]->(sp:Spec) RETURN co.companyName, cr.tdocNumber, collect(DISTINCT sp.specNumber) AS affectedSpecs ORDER BY cr.tdocNumber DESC LIMIT 15

questions.question: RAN1#121 회의에서 합의된 CR들의 변경 요약 종합은? (summaryOfChange 를 가진 CR 18건)
questions.cypher: MATCH (res:Resolution)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting {meetingNumber: 'RAN1#121'}) MATCH (res)-[:HAS_DISPOSITION]->(:DecisionDisposition {dispositionCode: 'agreed', evidenceStatus: 'source_verified'})-[:DISPOSITION_TARGET]->(cr:CR) WHERE cr.summaryOfChange IS NOT NULL RETURN m.meetingNumber, res.resolutionId, cr.tdocNumber, cr.summaryOfChange ORDER BY cr.tdocNumber DESC LIMIT 15
questions.approval_contract: Target-level dispositionCode=agreed + evidenceStatus=source_verified, bound to the exact Resolution and source span; REFERENCES and global document status do not assert approval.
